title: A 3D morphogenetic blueprint for metastatic outgrowth in breast cancer.
authors: Caire, Robin; Bordo, Roberta; Zanconato, Francesca; Panciera, Tito; Audoux, Estelle; Contessotto, Paolo; Fakiola, Michaela; Bason, Ramona; Romano, Oriana; Suli, Ambela; Battilana, Giusy; Marchionni, Matteo; Forcato, Mattia; Donzelli, Sara; Dieci, Maria Vittoria; Griguolo, Gaia; Carosi, Mariantonia; Fassan, Matteo; Guzzardo, Vincenza; Dei Tos, Angelo Paolo; Marsoni, Silvia; Wu, Pei-Hsun; Wirtz, Denis; He, Shanshan; Casali, Cecilia; Volpin, Francesco; Blandino, Giovanni; Tripodo, Claudio; Bicciato, Silvio; Guarneri, Valentina; Pagani, Massimiliano; Cordenonsi, Michelangelo; Piccolo, Stefano
one_liner_zh: 该文研究乳腺癌转移中的3D形态发生程序，虽涉及ETV转录因子与ChIP-seq，但核心是组织形态与肿瘤转移，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，AI仅用于成像分析，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: The tissue-level processes underpinning metastatic outgrowth remain unclear. We combined single-cell RNA sequencing, spatial transcriptomics, and AI-supported 3D imaging in human breast cancer with functional investigations in mice to uncover a 3D morphogenetic process essential for macrometastatic expansion. Macrometastases pervasively activate a metastatic trabecular morphogenesis (MTM) gene-expression program that redeploys developmental branching morphogenesis to build macrometastases as a 3D trabecular lattice of epithelial cords. MTM(HIGH) cells pre-exist in primary tumors destined to metastasize, whereas MTM(LOW) primaries are non-metastatic and display a compact, expansile growth architecture. Chromatin immunoprecipitation sequencing (ChIP-seq) on metastatic organoids identifies ETV1/4/5 as master regulators of MTM and branching cancer morphogenesis, required for metastatic outgrowth but dispensable for primary tumor take, bulk growth, and initial metastatic dissemination. Spatial and functional analyses reveal stromal fibroblast growth factor (FGF)-->fibroblast growth factor receptor (FGFR) signaling as an actionable MTM dependency. Thus, we link metastatic outgrowth to a 3D developmental morphogenetic process, exposing therapeutic vulnerabilities specific to the lethal macrometastatic stage.
abstract_zh: 支撑转移性生长的组织层面过程仍不清楚。我们将单细胞RNA测序、空间转录组学及AI支持的3D成像技术应用于人类乳腺癌，并结合小鼠功能研究，揭示了一个对巨转移性扩张至关重要的3D形态发生过程。巨转移灶普遍激活一种转移性小梁形态发生（MTM）基因表达程序，该程序重新部署发育性分支形态发生，将巨转移灶构建为上皮索的3D小梁网格。MTM(HIGH)细胞预先存在于注定要转移的原发肿瘤中，而MTM(LOW)原发肿瘤则非转移性，并表现出紧凑、膨胀性生长结构。对转移性类器官进行的染色质免疫沉淀测序（ChIP-seq）鉴定出ETV1/4/5为MTM和分支性癌症形态发生的主调控因子，这些因子对转移性生长是必需的，但对原发肿瘤形成、整体生长及初始转移播散则非必需。空间和功能分析揭示，基质成纤维细胞生长因子（FGF）→成纤维细胞生长因子受体（FGFR）信号传导是一个可靶向的MTM依赖性。因此，我们将转移性生长与一个3D发育形态发生过程联系起来，暴露了针对致死性巨转移阶段特有的治疗脆弱性。
